title: Main Kar Lungi
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Aachu's 'main kar lungi' is not a request for distance; it is pride asking to stay whole, and Zuv's love is the quiet care that helps without making her feel small.
emotional_arc: independent-love universal hook -> hidden don't-go-far translation -> Aachu pride proof -> Zuv's quiet public care -> care-without-a-scene thesis
source_story_summary: Selected B concept: Main kar lungi. Translation: don't go far. She wanted to do it herself. He helped like it was nothing. Maybe love is care without making a scene. Visual council winner: Public Thresholds / Crowded World, Private Orbit. Use outdoor public movement, no home interiors, no repeated rocks, no repeated red shoes, no prop-first visual system.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable Instagram carousel slide in a soft hand-drawn flat vector / desi storybook illustration style matching the supplied reference carousel examples. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but with the richer model-native handwritten text, faces, outfits, and brandmark composition shown in the style references. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles and Layer E story-selling cards.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner keeps the spine the creator chose while correcting the visual failure: the premise is the universal double-message of independent love, Aachu's proof is the proud 'main kar lungi', Zuv's role is active but quiet care, and the visuals stay outdoors.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: expressive Aachu anti-ideal -> concrete pride proof -> Zuv's calm active care -> tender acceptance thesis.
final_public_slide_copy_direction: She wanted to do it herself.
He helped like it was nothing.
Maybe love is care without making a scene.

candidates.name: Main Kar Lungi
candidates.universal_truth: Some independent people are not saying leave me alone; they are saying help me without making me feel small.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's full-pride 'main kar lungi' carries a hidden please stay close.
candidates.concrete_proof: An outdoor public threshold, her determined posture, and Zuv helping so quietly the moment stays hers.
candidates.zuv_role: He reads the translation and offers care without turning it into a scene.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is care without making a scene.

candidates.name: Help Without Shrinking
candidates.universal_truth: The right help does not reduce someone's independence.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu wants to do the moment herself, but wants Zuv near.
candidates.concrete_proof: He opens the path, steadies one small thing, and lets her lead.
candidates.zuv_role: His care protects her pride instead of correcting her.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is help that leaves your pride whole.

candidates.name: Don't Go Far
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes independence is not distance; it is trust that someone will stay close.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Her sentence says I can do it, but the rhythm says stay here.
candidates.concrete_proof: A glance back on an outdoor path, Zuv close enough without crowding her.
candidates.zuv_role: He respects both messages at once.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love knows when close is enough.

candidates.name: The Quiet Hand
candidates.universal_truth: Care lands deepest when it does not announce itself.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu keeps her main-character pride while Zuv quietly solves the tiny practical edge.
candidates.concrete_proof: One easy hand at the gate or bag, then both keep walking.
candidates.zuv_role: He helps without taking over the scene.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe attention is love before it becomes a request.

candidates.name: Pride Stayed Whole
candidates.universal_truth: Being loved well can make independence feel safer, not threatened.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Her determined softness remains the center of the moment.
candidates.concrete_proof: Outdoor movement, respectful distance, and one tiny assist.
candidates.zuv_role: He makes the help feel like partnership, not rescue.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe love is being helped and still feeling like yourself.
